card.name: Spaces and operators before numeric amounts
card.fires_on: The space or operator (/, ×, space) that comes right before a number in a composition statement or calculation formula. It fires where a quantity is about to be written, as in 'and <<>>15 mcg' or 'Weight (kg) <<×>> 0.'

modes.label: Space before an ingredient amount
modes.description: The blank space after 'and' or a parenthesis, just before the next ingredient's amount in a product composition line.
modes.example: contains 45 mg lidocaine and<< >>15 mcg epinephrine

modes.label: Operator in a formula
modes.description: A slash or multiplication sign in a dosing or lab formula, just before the next number or variable.

card.writes: It seems to prepare the model to output a digit or number next, with no clear link to the listed tokens.
card.plain: It marks the spot right before a number is written in a drug composition line or calculation formula.
